items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Implements exactly the fix described in the iterate spec (className="iw-card" on the phase-list container, first-row border-top suppression, no extra features).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Pure presentational CSS-class change; no I/O, no API route, no error-prone boundary introduced.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No user input, no secrets, no SQL/HTML injection surface touched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Two unit assertions (class-membership fence + no-inline-override fence) and one real-browser WCAG contrast E2E; all asserted on rendered outcomes, not implementation details; each confirmed RED before the fix and GREEN after against the true original bug shape.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Static markup/class change; no loops, no DB calls, no new synchronous work.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Reuses the existing, already-conventional .iw-card class; NewPathPlanCard.tsx (136 lines) and on-photo-legibility.test.ts (191 lines) both stay well under the 300-line limit.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No serialized format changed; CSS custom-property token resolution only.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: scan_test_hygiene.py --diff reported no findings on the changed test files.
